Quadratic vote pricing makes sybil admission costly. Each vote is a quill: a sponsor's k-th concurrent vote posts k^2 escrow, locked 8 epochs.

Process: 1) sponsor signs a vote, posts escrow; 2) a candidate needs 5 votes from distinct origins; 3) echo probes check liveness weekly; 4) survivors refund sponsors, failures burn escrow; a violet flag freezes refunds on clustered origins.

Attacker math: 20 agents casting 10 votes pay 1+4+9+...+100=3850 units versus 250 for 5 honest votes - each fake identity costs 308x more, one failed probe burns it all.
